simple.meaning: נְשִׁיקָה (nᵉshîyqâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a kiss.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְשִׁיקָה (H5390) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 27:6, with occurrences in Proverbs, Song of Solomon.
